about: Canonical ZAPCO station dataset (P1.5 Stage B, B1). Hand-maintained source of truth; scripts/lab/p15_build_stations.mjs derives the served public/lab/p15/stations.json and the map positions. Every field carries value (v), source (src), status and date checked. Status: website_claim = ZAPCO's own listing, not independently checked; corroborated = an independent public dataset agrees; third_party = a named third-party listing, not confirmed by ZAPCO; public_record = a government record about the site, not about ZAPCO; owner_evidence = material the owner supplied; lead = cited as a lead only, not used as data. Nothing here establishes that ZAPCO currently owns or operates a site. Unknown fields are absent, never guessed.

origin.note: local metres: x east, y north; equirectangular at the origin latitude
